# Lab 28.4: Governed Data Sharing

## What We Are Going to Do
Share customer analytics with a partner safely: classify and protect PII, mask what must stay hidden, run joint analysis in a clean room, and publish a listing with egress controls.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Build the data to share.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS cap4 OPTIONS (location = 'US');
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE cap4.customers AS
SELECT id AS user_id, email, first_name, country, age, traffic_source
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users`;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Discover PII (Lab 18.11).** Run a Sensitive Data Protection profile on `cap4`. Confirm `email` and `first_name` are flagged.

3. **[CLI] Protect columns (Labs 18.5–18.6).** Attach the **PII** policy tag to `email` and `first_name`, and add a **SHA-256 masking rule** for the partner's group, so joins on hashed email still work.

4. **[SQL] Create a clean-room view with an aggregation threshold (Lab 17.4).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW cap4.customers_dcr
OPTIONS (privacy_policy = '{"aggregation_threshold_policy": {"threshold": 50, "privacy_unit_columns": ["user_id"]}}')
AS SELECT user_id, country, age, traffic_source FROM cap4.customers;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Publish.** Add `customers_dcr` to a clean room with a **join restriction on `user_id`**, and publish a separate aggregated listing with **egress controls** (Lab 17.3). Subscribe from the partner project and run an aggregated query.

6. **[SQL] Audit (Lab 18.12 / 17.3).**

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Discovery | PII found automatically |
| Protection | Policy tags + masking |
| Clean room | Only aggregated, thresholded results |
| Oversight | Usage visible to the publisher |
